verdict.rationale: Docs describe agents running in isolated sandboxes that install dependencies and test changes, with GitHub App access granting repo cloning rights, and a setup-commands endpoint that analyzes repo structure to auto-generate environment setup, plus log analysis to fix setup errors. This directly covers autonomous clone/install/configure workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the clone+setup flow and explicit end-to-end walkthrough beyond first-party docs.
